name: wp-stream
description: Stream tracks logged-in user activity so you can monitor every change made on your WordPress site in beautifully organized detail. All activity is organized by context, action and IP address for easy filtering. Developers can extend Stream with custom connectors to log any kind of action.
author: XWP

scripts.test:php-unit: wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/stream -- composer test-unit
scripts.test:php: wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/stream -- vendor/bin/phpunit --no-coverage
scripts.test:php-multisite: wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/stream -- bash -c 'WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-multisite.xml --no-coverage'
scripts.test-xdebug: wp-env start --xdebug && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/stream -- vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.large-records-remove: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'wp db query < wp-content/plugins/stream/local/scripts/large-datasets/remove-test-logs.sql'
scripts.large-records-generate: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'wp db query < wp-content/plugins/stream/local/scripts/large-datasets/bulk-insert-logs.sql'
scripts.large-records-show: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'wp db query < wp-content/plugins/stream/local/scripts/large-datasets/show-stream-db-stats.sql'
